scope:
Resolve current project inventory world states and exact MODELDEF coverage.

This isolated, once-only diagnostic reads project classes from the supplied PK3,
observes native Inventory defaults and resolves legal catalogue combinations.
It does not establish model visibility, ordinary handling or author acceptance.
limitations: Ancestor candidates require native visual verification; static association is not proof of rendered model visibility.

Finite catalogue combinations use existing public update functions and legal-essence rules. Some material-tier inputs normalize to the same effective identity. Custom third-party classes and future content are outside this observed package.
Native defaults exclude undroppable/untossable/invisible spawn states; dynamic equipment/material families are covered explicitly.
This is a once-only isolated diagnostic with no campaign or save mutation and no production actor scan.
